name: Portal 2: Project 2009
storyline: Awakening from Extended Relaxation, you find yourself in a run down Aperture Science long after the downfall of GLaDOS. However, not even post-apocalyptic conditions save you from being tested on; as her pre-recorded messages guide you through abandoned tests in the hopes you will reactivate the Enrichment Center's test supervisor.
summary: Experience an accuracy focused nearly 1:1 recreation of Portal 2's early 2009 story. Made over the last 4 years by a team of Portal enthusiasts and beta researchers, this 2 hour long digital experience features Mel, the cut GLaDOS hub, new personality spheres and dozens of previously unseen areas.
